topic: HUF governance -- charter, carrier-filter doctrine, Ratio Blindness / MC-4, and the evidence case-studies.

paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the HUF repo root; cross_repo paths name the other repo.

specific_knowledge.what: HUF-Gov is the governance + scientific-method layer. It holds the carrier-filter doctrine (need-to-know / withhold-on-distribution; reconstructable reduction as a redaction boundary), the governance charter, the Ratio Blindness doctrine, and the MC-4 instrument claim. MC-4 = the FOURTH monitoring category (MC-1 magnitude, MC-2 identity, MC-3 trend, MC-4 composition): ignoring the ratios leaves ~1/4 of the monitoring picture undiagnosed -- 'see or remain blind.'
key_results: Tier 1: MC-4 detections (Germany nuclear shutdown d_A=9.07; Japan Fukushima 9.05; UK coal/COVID ~3.2) all found without being told; 5-AI literature check found no prior art (4 defeat paths remain the falsifiability test)

Tier 2: Ratio Blindness cost ~1/4 = the 4th of 4 monitoring categories ignored (category-count heuristic, NOT a measured 25%); evidence: COPD trial (magnitude p>0.05, MC-4 unmasked) + the Hs gas study (40/60 alarms-green)
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = the EMBER MC-4 detections; Tier 2 = the four-category framing + the 1/4 heuristic; Tier 3 = any claim the cost is exactly 1/4 in a given domain (measured per case).

bring_your_own_ai: Start at HUF_GOVERNANCE_CHARTER.md + CARRIER_FILTER_DOCTRINE.md; for the ratio principle read RATIO_BLINDNESS_DOCTRINE.md + the MC-4 instrument note. Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply.
governance: HUF-STD-001/002/003; carrier-filter governs disclosure; human authorship for claims; no AI commits.
